emptyFiles.badgeStyle.description: Choose the visual icon style for empty files in the Explorer tree.

emptyFiles.folders.markdownDescription: Mark folders that hold empty files, at any depth, with `∋`; the tooltip gives the count. Paths in `#files.exclude#` and `#search.exclude#` are not counted. The workspace is scanned once at startup: turn this off if that is slow on a very large one.

emptyFiles.whitespaceOnly.markdownDescription: Also mark files that hold only whitespace: spaces, tabs, empty lines, a byte order mark. Files over 64 KiB are not read and never count.

description: Highlights empty files in the explorer sidebar
name: empty-file-highlighter
